title: A comparison language is in logarithmic space
statement: Let $L$ be the language of bit strings of the form $\langle 1^n,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle$ with $i<n$, where the pairing doubles each bit of the first component, appends the separator $01$, and then appends the second component, and $\operatorname{bits}(i)$ is the binary expansion of $i$. Then $L$ is decidable by a deterministic finite-state multi-tape Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $\lfloor\log_2 m\rfloor+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $m$, with the value at $m=0$ taken to be $1$.
